# Network_State_Awareness

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-15

## Definition
The continuous monitoring and modeling of network conditions to inform routing and reliability decisions in real time. Provides the situational intelligence needed for topology-centric systems to adapt to physical or logical network changes efficiently.
